description: List the saved payment methods (used only to pay for flight bookings, not for cards or adding funds). Returns each method with its id, brand, last 4 digits, and expiry, and marks the default one. Use setup_payment_method to add a new one. The gated tools set_default_payment_method and remove_payment_method also exist; call them by name even though they aren't in the tools list.
name: list_payment_methods

defaultId.description: The id of the payment method marked as default, if any.

message.description: Human-readable summary of the saved payment methods.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default payment method.

status.description: Whether any payment methods are saved.
